    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Admin
    System administrator — has full access to user management and activity logs.
    AdminService
    Service for admin operations: managing users and viewing system activity logs.
    AuthService
    Stateless authentication gateway.
    Citation
    Records who cited a research paper and what they wrote about it.
    Complaint
    A formal teacher complaint about a student, sent to dean.
    ComplaintService
    Manages formal complaints filed by teachers about students.
    Course
    A university course with its schedule, marks per student, and assigned instructors.
    CourseRegistrationRequest
    A student's request to enrol in a specific course.
    CourseService
    Handles course browsing, student registration/dropping, and manager approval workflows.
    CourseType
    Describes a course's role in the curriculum — required major, optional minor, or open elective.
    Database
    Singleton in-memory database for the KBTU university system.
    Employee
    Abstract base for all salaried university staff (Teacher, Manager, Admin, TechSupport).
    GraduateStudent
    A master's or PhD student.
    I18n
    In-code string table for KZ / EN / RU.
    InteractiveMenu
    Interactive CLI for the KBTU University System.
    InvalidSupervisorException
    Thrown when a proposed research supervisor doesn't meet the minimum h-index requirement.
    JournalObserver
    Observer interface for research journal subscriptions (Observer pattern).
    JournalService
    Manages research journals: creation, listing, and subscription.
    LanguageType
    Supported UI languages in the system.
    Lesson
    Represents a scheduled lesson (lecture or practice) with room and time.
    LessonType
    Whether a scheduled lesson is a lecture or a hands-on practice session.
    Main
    Entry point for the KBTU University System.
    Manager
    University manager.
    ManagerService
    Manager-level operations: course/teacher management, reports, news, and student views.
    ManagerType
    Distinguishes between an Office of the Registrar (OR) manager and a departmental manager.
    Mark
    Represents a student's academic mark for a course.
    MarkService
    Handles mark assignment and the downstream effects on student GPA and fail count.
    Message
    A direct message sent from one user to another within the university system.
    MessageService
    Handles sending and retrieving direct messages between users.
    News
    A university news item.
    Notification
    A system notification delivered to a user's inbox.
    NotificationService
    Retrieves and displays notifications for a user, marking them as read on view.
    NotResearcherException
    Thrown when a non-researcher user tries to join or act within a research project.
    Organization
    A student organization with a designated leader and a list of members.
    OrganizationService
    Manages student organizations: creation, membership, and join-request handling.
    OrgJoinRequest
    A student's request to join an existing student organization.
    PaperComparators
    Strategy pattern: a catalogue of ready-made Comparators for sorting ResearchPaper collections.
    ProjectJoinRequest
    A researcher's request to join an existing research project.
    ProjectService
    Manages research projects: creation, discovery, and join-request handling.
    Request
    Tech-support request submitted by any employee.
    RequestService
    Handles generic requests and researcher-role promotion requests.
    RequestStatus
    Lifecycle states for any request: opened → accepted/rejected → completed.
    Researcher
    Capability interface for users who can publish and analyse research papers.
    ResearcherDecorator
    Decorator (Decorator pattern) that adds researcher capabilities to any User.
    ResearcherRequest
    A user's request to be granted researcher status.
    ResearchJournal
    A named research journal (Observer pattern subject).
    ResearchPaper
    An academic research paper with metadata and citation tracking.
    ResearchProject
    A collaborative research project.
    ResearchService
    Orchestrates all research-related operations: papers, citations, supervisors, and rankings.
    Role
    All possible roles a user can hold in the university system.
    SalaryService
    Handles salary payments for employees.
    School
    Faculties / schools within KBTU.
    StaffBoardService
    Manages the employee-only staff bulletin board.
    StaffBulletin
    A staff bulletin board post.
    Student
    Undergraduate student.
    Teacher
    Represents a university teacher.
    TeacherRatingService
    Allows students to submit ratings for their teachers.
    TeacherTitle
    Academic rank of a teacher.
    TechSupportSpecialist
    Tech-support specialist responsible for handling employee requests.
    UrgencyLevel
    Priority level attached to requests and complaints.
    User
    Abstract base for all users in the KBTU system.
    UserFactory
    Factory (Factory Method pattern) for creating all user types.
    UserFactory.UserType
     
    UserLookupService
    Read-only views of students, teachers, and course-to-teacher relationships.
